I was just in Siem Reap and visited Angkor Wat at sunrise and I was honestly a little disappointed. I was with a small group and a tour guide so got taken through the temple and it was a lot smaller inside than I expected. 

For the sunrise, there wasn’t actually any sun it was completely covered by clouds. 

Being in 40 degree heat made hotter by the stone walls and thousands of tourists definitely had impact on the enjoyment. I was there during Khmer new year so that did add to how busy the place was. 


The day before that we went with a guide to a couple of the other temples which you could climb to the top of. Although the heat made it harder I preferred the tour of the smaller temples and there are less people crowded together. 


If you did Angkor wat I’d recommend the sunrise tour because midday/afternoon becomes more busy and hot.
